name: Speed Run Simulator ⚡
desc:
🌞 SWEAT YOURSELF THROUGH THIS SUMMER'S EVENT! 🌞
- Check out the new, limited time summer map!
- Unlock 4 hot obbies! It's really got me sweatin'! 🥵
- Get access to 8 (!!!) new amazing pets; Vibing Seastar, Silly Icecream, Tanning Pineapple, Big Friendly Bumblebee, Shiny Pearl, Summer Sheep, Sunshine & Earth Butterfly!
- Sting yourself with epicness using the new Summer Super-Size Pet: Blob the Jellyfish!

HOW TO
⚡ Get faster by tapping your screen. 
⚡ Purchase pets and gain rebirths to increase the amount of speed per tap.
⚡ When you have enough speed & rebirths, unlock obbies that lead to new areas! 🏃‍♂️
